description: This file defines enums, constants, structures, and classes related to the protocol types used in the confui component of the project, including message types, commands, and response handling.

classes.name: ConfUiMessage
classes.description: Base class for all confui protocol messages, providing common interface and session management.

classes.name: ConfUiGenericMessage
classes.description: Template class for generic confui messages identified by a command.

classes.name: ConfUiAckMessage
classes.description: Represents acknowledgment messages with success status and optional message.

classes.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage
classes.description: Represents user response messages, including confirmation, cancellation, and touch events.

classes.name: ConfUiStartMessage
classes.description: Message to initiate a confui session with optional prompt and UI options.

classes.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage
classes.description: Message indicating a user touch event with coordinates.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiCmd enum to its string representation.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Provides a debug string for a ConfUiCmd, optionally with debug info.

methods.name: ToCmd
methods.description: Converts a string or integer to a ConfUiCmd enum.

methods.name: ConfUiMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the message to a string.

methods.name: ConfUiMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the message over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiAckMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment message over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes user response message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends user response message over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends start message over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes user selection message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends user selection message over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes user touch message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends user touch message over a shared file descriptor.
